_readme: Phrase bank for humanize_transcript.py. Each key is a category; 'detect' is a list of case-insensitive regex patterns matched against the raw NotebookLM transcript text (matches are resolved earliest-first, no overlaps); 'alternatives' is the rotation pool a replacement is drawn from. 'template: true' categories use a named capture group ('ask' for cta_outro) that gets spliced into the chosen alternative via {ask} — this preserves the per-episode-specific content (e.g. which comment to leave) while only varying the fixed frame around it. Keep every alternative in the same register as the show: casual, informed, a little wry co-host banter — never formal or robotic, that defeats the point.
